description: Phase 8.2 work slices. Each slice is a unit of work in one stream; its ID is qualified by that stream and, where a plan defines the slice, uses the plan's number. A slice lists the acceptance cases (docs/roadmap/08-2-convex-cutover-acceptance.json) it advances. `queue` is the scheduled order of open work. Since the 2026-10-02 re-cut (D80) it holds only vertical slices (stream VS): each names the criteria it closes (`criteria`) and the older open slices it finishes (`includes`). Every open criterion and every open older slice belongs to exactly one queued vertical slice. Validated and reported by scripts/acceptanceProgress.mjs.

stateMeaning.integrating: Source written and compiling; tests have not passed yet. Becomes done when the vertical slice that includes it proves its criteria.
stateMeaning.waiting: Blocked on a user decision or approval.
stateMeaning.superseded: Replaced by the slice named in its refs.

streams.title: Room authority (ADR 0035)
streams.purpose: The Session room becomes the authority for live play; Convex becomes the record. The critical path to R06.

streams.title: Content snapshots (ADR 0036)
streams.purpose: Builder and room read published content from snapshot files instead of Convex queries.

streams.title: Completion plan (2026-09-24)
streams.purpose: The earlier completion plan: groundwork, Campaign-owned play, room dispatch and gameplay rules. Its final slice moved to REL-6.

streams.title: Rules and combat
streams.purpose: Rules correctness and coverage found during play-testing and SRD sweeps.

streams.title: Cost and speed
streams.purpose: Free-tier cost and latency. Live-play items are measured by V15.

streams.title: Platform and product
streams.purpose: Hosting, tiers, media and product features decided through open questions.

streams.title: Test suite health
streams.purpose: Enabling work: makes the test-and-fix cycle and the R08 lifecycle fast and reliable. Advances no criterion directly.

streams.title: Proof and release
streams.purpose: Turns integrating work into accepted cases, then runs the final proof and promotion (gate 5).

streams.title: Vertical slices (2026-10-02 re-cut)
streams.purpose: Each slice closes named criteria with a focused proof and finishes the older slices it includes. The V15 load run, final proof and promotion come last (D80).
